sources.title: RLUSD on the XRP Ledger — live supply and finalized flow
RLUSD is now available on Coinbase

exchange_balance_observation.interpretation: This provider's October 31 7-day Binance wallet-label aggregate is +17.6M XRP, not the -173.2M previously captured on October 30. The one-day update and provider wallet-set revisions require a time-series diff and five-source-wallet crosswalk. The current positive 7-day balance is a disconfirming observation to a persistent Binance reserve-depletion narrative, but it does not prove whether the incident wallets were replenished or excluded/reclassified.
limitations: Wallet labels are provider-attributed, not an official Binance reserve export.
Tracked exchange balances include cold custody and tagged wrapped/custody balances; they are not tradable order-book float.

The earlier -173.2M Binance 7-day figure and current +17.6M figure differ sharply; this may reflect the different end date, subsequent inflows, wallet-label revision or methodology change. Do not splice without raw daily series.
No same-time customer-liability denominator is provided.

etf_flow_observation.limitation: Holdings change is not automatically external net capital or unhedged spot buying; fund universe and settlement corrections remain relevant.

rlusd_supply_observation.key_scope_limit: The xrpldashboard OpenAPI contract explicitly defines get_rlusd_supply as Ethereum + XRPL only and get_rlusd_flow_24h as finalized XRPL net change. Base is not included in this provider's stated two-chain total.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Part of the XRPL RLUSD decline reflects migration to Ethereum/Base after Coinbase added all three deposit/withdrawal networks on Oct 28.
competing_hypotheses.supporting: Coinbase listing timing; Ethereum supply increased in the same rolling 24h window; Base is excluded from the dashboard's Ethereum+XRPL scope.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming: Ethereum's +19.6M rolling mint offsets only part of the -67.6M XRPL rolling change; Base supply and bridge transaction paths are not captured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Part of the XRPL decline reflects net redemptions/burns rather than chain migration.
competing_hypotheses.supporting: XRPL issuer-obligation snapshots fell; the dashboard's rolling XRPL flow is negative; historical Bitquery research documents large RLUSD redemption-wallet transfers to issuer.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming: The current source does not publish transaction-level burn/redemption IDs for this exact window; Base chain supply is excluded.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Some discrepancy reflects stale or differing provider coverage and snapshot methodology.
competing_hypotheses.supporting: DefiLlama, XR-Lineage, stables.cool and xrpldashboard displayed materially different XRPL supply levels/cutoffs.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming: xrpldashboard reports a daily gateway_balances snapshot and an independent RPC cross-check; stables.cool shows a similar 707.4M level.
